name: Lustful Phone
source:
Lustful Phone is an erotic text-based game, taking place in the phone of Gaby, that you're gonna play as. She's a girl who knows what she likes, and will do anything to have what she wants. She's not like her [url=/v45412]best friend[/url] at all... Use her phone to chat with her family, or her sexfriends! Or maybe go match with some new faces on [s]Tinder[/s] DickFinder! Plan your date with Google, and write about it in your Diary! Will you unlock every pics in her gallery? You'll send nudes, receive nudes... 

Gaby's dominant, empowered, and very kinky. She's quite the gal.

And yet, you're the one who'll decide where her life is going!

[From [url=https://aason.itch.io/lustful-phone]Itch.io[/url]]
